Name: Upgraded Kegs
Author: zhanx1224
Description:
From [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2321]Upgraded Machines[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2650]Upgraded Seed Makers[/url] I got inspirated and decided to upgrade the kegs as well.

Tired of placing hundreds of kegs? Afraid that kegs would be crushed by NPCs walking by? Here is one solution. Upgraded Kegs provides 4 new kegs to make things easier and more efficient.

Compared with vanilla kegs, the processing time of upgraded ones is not changed, but the quantity of ingredients and products are both multiplied by:
[list]
[*]Copper Keg - 5x
[*]Iron Keg - 20x
[*]Gold Keg - 80x
[*]Iridium Keg - 320x
[/list]
Recipe of one keg = Wood*30 + Oak Resin*5 + (this kind of metal bar)*5
You can call the Iridium Keg a 320x keg someway. Quite clear right? :D

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]CFAutomate[/url] (in the Files tab of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]) are recommended if you are dealing with thousands of ingredients or wish the kegs run automatically and cyclically. Specially, the Iridium Keg produces 320 cups of coffee and consumes 1,600 coffee beans at one time. You may be not able to do this with your hand itself, but with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]CFAutomate[/url] it will be done.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url] is required. For CFR v2.9.10 or later, just extract mods into "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder.

Also try my other mods if you like!
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4439]Upgraded Preserves Jars[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4460]Upgraded Casks[/url]﻿
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4400]Superhuge Greenhouse[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4477]Easy Gift - Everybody Loves Parsnips[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4478]Common Legendary Fish[/url]﻿
[/list]
Have fun!

[b]ChangeLog[/b]
v1.2.0: CFR v2.10.16 now has some problems with custom machines that accept categories but not specific items. So I list all the ingredients in configuration to avoid the problems. Some strange problems for vanilla crops will no longer happen.
v1.1.0: Vegetables produce juice correctly now.
